A.description: single LLM, same evidence, same schema
A.tool_configuration: no tool calls; results of check_policy_period, check_part_prices and find_prior_claims given in the prompt; policy wording through Knowledge; no task guardrails

B.tool_configuration: tools over MCP (./claimsight_tools): Policy Analyst check_policy_period; Fraud Analyst check_part_prices, find_prior_claims; policy wording through Knowledge; task guardrails on all three tasks

C.why: ClaimSight + vision is Phase 3; the Damage Analyst does not exist yet

notes: Escalations are their own category: neither a correct approval nor a correct rejection.
Fraud claims are routed to a person by design (fraud score >= 0.5), so their escalation is expected; see escalation_by_fault_type.
Line-item scores count denied lines as the positive class, and leave out claims that are not covered at all.
Payouts are the settlement calculator's, from each configuration's line decisions; the calculator is shared.
Tokens are as the provider reported them. No money cost is estimated.
Development claims only: the prompts were tuned on these, which favours B.
